scan.heading: Scan a barcode
scan.hint: Point the camera at the barcode on the pack.
scan.permissionDenied: We do not have camera access. You can still search by name, or type the barcode.
scan.notSupported: This browser cannot use the camera for scanning. Search by name instead.
scan.notFound: We do not have this barcode yet.
scan.ambiguous: This barcode matches more than one product in our data. Please pick the right one.
capture.heading: Photograph the label
capture.hint: Fill the frame with the nutrition panel. Good light helps.
capture.unreadable: We could not read that image. Try again with more light and the panel flat.
capture.confirmBody: We read these from your photo. Please correct anything that is wrong — we will not produce a result until you confirm.
capture.lowConfidence: We are unsure about this one. Please check it.
capture.contribute: Also add this product to the shared catalogue
capture.unavailable: Label capture will be available once the secure label-reading service is connected. Until then, search by name or use the barcode on the pack.
scan.barcodeInvalid: That does not look like a barcode. Barcodes are 8 to 14 digits.
capture.comingSoonTitle: Label reading is on its way
